package probe

import "os/exec"

// The result type holds a command and is refused, the slice literal's type at
// the return line is refused as any composite type is, and the construction
// inside it, which the check cannot follow, is refused where it is built (P2).
func sliceElement() []*exec.Cmd {
	return []*exec.Cmd{
		exec.Command("sh"),
	}
}
